why: Telemetry for the code case: one metric series and one log line. The series is the only number the text states -- roughly three percent of exports fail -- and the log line is the only place the mechanism appears, because an uncaught exception is not a metric. There is no span: the text gives a consequence (`the broker sees the connection close`) and no duration, and a span without a duration would be a number nobody wrote.

series.why: the checkpoint `cp-failure-ratio` holds it; the baseline of zero is the text's own framing of a fault that began with a change in the data, not in the code path

logs.body: unhandled TypeError in the CSV writer: a column contained an embedded newline
logs.quote: Logs show an unhandled TypeError in the CSV writer when a column contains an embedded newline
logs.why: the mechanism stated in words by the system itself, which is what makes this case a code fault rather than a resource one
